Requirement You are not in an encounter and can see the ground you expect to fight over.

Pick a vantage point and settle into it. If an encounter begins while you remain there, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll and your first ranged Strike of the encounter ignores the target's lesser cover. Moving from the vantage ends the benefit for the rest of the encounter.

cinderfall.incomplete: the +2 circumstance to an initiative roll would, in isolation, be a trivially real FlatModifier (selector: "initiative"), but it's gated behind an untracked setup condition ("picked a vantage point, stayed there, combat starts") with no roll-option/flag mechanism and no companion effect item here to carry that state — so the card as a whole stays INCOMPLETE, with the initiative clause flagged as the one piece likely real in isolation.
